description: Auto-update the shared @geniemarketing/* packages so this site rides the latest UI/motion + foundation. CI validates each bump before merge.

packageRules.description: Deferred major migrations. Each was evaluated and intentionally held — it needs a dedicated, tested upgrade, not an auto-PR: Tailwind v4 (CSS-engine rewrite; closed #51/#60), lucide v1 (removed brand icons, breaks the build; #58/#61), pnpm v11 (build-script allowlist + node_modules-purge/Amplify-cache; #50), Biome v2 (117 new lint issues; #46). Minor/patch updates for these still flow. To do one of these migrations, remove its name from matchPackageNames.
